A man stood on a railroad bridge in northern Alabama, looking down into the swift water twenty feet below, his hands tied behind his back. <break time="0.8s" /> A rope around his neck was fastened to a beam above his head, and he stood on a loose board laid across the railroad ties. <break time="0.8s" /> Two Union soldiers and their sergeant stood beside him on the board, and nearby stood a captain, who watched quietly with his arms folded. <break time="0.8s" /> At each end of the bridge stood a guard with his rifle held straight up in front of his chest. <break time="0.8s" /> The man who was about to die was about thirty five years old, and he was dressed like a rich planter, not like a soldier. <break time="0.8s" /> When he closed his eyes to think of his wife and children, a sharp, ringing sound like a hammer striking iron broke into his thoughts. <break time="0.8s" /> It was only the ticking of his watch, but each tick seemed slower and louder than the one before. <break time="0.8s" /> Then a wild hope came to him that he might free his hands, throw off the rope, and swim home to his family. <break time="0.8s" /> Just as these thoughts flashed through his mind, the captain nodded to the sergeant, and the sergeant stepped off the board.

한 남자가 철교 위에 서 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 앨라배마 북부의. <break time="0.8s" /> 빠른 물살을 내려다보며. <break time="0.8s" /> 20피트 아래의. <break time="0.8s" /> 두 손이 등 뒤로 묶인 채로. <break time="0.8s" /> 그의 목에 감긴 밧줄은. <break time="0.8s" /> 머리 위의 들보에 고정되어 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그는 느슨한 판자 위에 서 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 판자는 철로 침목 위에 가로놓여 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 북군 병사 두 명과 그들의 하사관이. <break time="0.8s" /> 판자 위 그의 곁에 서 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 가까이에는 대위 한 명이 서 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 조용히 지켜보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 팔짱을 낀 채로. <break time="0.8s" /> 다리의 양쪽 끝에는. <break time="0.8s" /> 보초가 한 명씩 서 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 소총을 똑바로 세워 든 채로. <break time="0.8s" /> 가슴 앞에. <break time="0.8s" /> 곧 죽게 될 그 남자는. <break time="0.8s" /> 서른다섯 살쯤이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 부유한 농장주처럼 차려입고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 군인 같은 차림은 아니었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 눈을 감았을 때. <break time="0.8s" /> 아내와 아이들을 생각하려고. <break time="0.8s" /> 날카롭게 울리는 소리가. <break time="0.8s" /> 쇠를 내리치는 망치 같은. <break time="0.8s" /> 그의 생각을 깨뜨렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것은 그의 시계가 째깍거리는 소리일 뿐이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 째깍 소리 하나하나가. <break time="0.8s" /> 더 느리고 더 크게 느껴졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 바로 앞의 소리보다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그때 터무니없는 희망이 그에게 떠올랐다. <break time="0.8s" /> 두 손을 풀고. <break time="0.8s" /> 밧줄을 벗어 던지고. <break time="0.8s" /> 가족에게 헤엄쳐 돌아갈 수 있을지도 모른다는. <break time="0.8s" /> 바로 이런 생각들이. <break time="0.8s" /> 그의 머릿속을 스쳐 갈 때. <break time="0.8s" /> 대위가 하사관에게 고개를 끄덕였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 하사관은 판자에서 물러났다.

Peyton Farquhar. <break time="0.8s" /> A wealthy planter from an old Alabama family. <break time="0.8s" /> Was a slave owner. <break time="0.8s" /> Who strongly supported. <break time="0.8s" /> The Southern side in the war. <break time="0.8s" /> Unable to join the army. <break time="0.8s" /> For reasons he could not control. <break time="0.8s" /> He longed for a chance. <break time="0.8s" /> To do something brave for the South. <break time="0.8s" /> One evening. <break time="0.8s" /> While Farquhar and his wife. <break time="0.8s" /> Were sitting on a bench near the gate. <break time="0.8s" /> A soldier in a gray uniform. <break time="0.8s" /> Rode up to them. <break time="0.8s" /> Missus Farquhar was glad. <break time="0.8s" /> To bring him a cup of water. <break time="0.8s" /> And while she was gone. <break time="0.8s" /> Her husband eagerly asked. <break time="0.8s" /> For news from the front. <break time="0.8s" /> The soldier said that the Northern army had reached the Owl Creek bridge. <break time="0.8s" /> Where they were repairing the railroad. <break time="0.8s" /> And had built a small fort. <break time="0.8s" /> Any civilian caught. <break time="0.8s" /> Damaging the railroad or its bridges. <break time="0.8s" /> Will be hanged. <break time="0.8s" /> He added. <break time="0.8s" /> And I have seen the order myself. <break time="0.8s" /> Smiling, Farquhar asked. <break time="0.8s" /> What a brave man could do there. <break time="0.8s" /> If he managed to get past the guard. <break time="0.8s" /> At the end of the bridge. <break time="0.8s" /> The soldier answered that a great pile of dry driftwood. <break time="0.8s" /> Lay against the wooden pier. <break time="0.8s" /> And that it would burn very easily. <break time="0.8s" /> Later that night. <break time="0.8s" /> The soldier rode back past the plantation. <break time="0.8s" /> In the opposite direction. <break time="0.8s" /> For he was really. <break time="0.8s" /> A Northern scout in disguise.

Peyton Farquhar, a wealthy planter from an old Alabama family, was a slave owner who strongly supported the Southern side in the war. <break time="0.8s" /> Unable to join the army for reasons he could not control, he longed for a chance to do something brave for the South. <break time="0.8s" /> One evening, while Farquhar and his wife were sitting on a bench near the gate, a soldier in a gray uniform rode up to them. <break time="0.8s" /> Missus Farquhar was glad to bring him a cup of water, and while she was gone, her husband eagerly asked for news from the front. <break time="0.8s" /> The soldier said that the Northern army had reached the Owl Creek bridge, where they were repairing the railroad and had built a small fort. <break time="0.8s" /> Any civilian caught damaging the railroad or its bridges will be hanged, he added, and I have seen the order myself. <break time="0.8s" /> Smiling, Farquhar asked what a brave man could do there if he managed to get past the guard at the end of the bridge. <break time="0.8s" /> The soldier answered that a great pile of dry driftwood lay against the wooden pier, and that it would burn very easily. <break time="0.8s" /> Later that night the soldier rode back past the plantation in the opposite direction, for he was really a Northern scout in disguise.

페이턴 파쿼는. <break time="0.8s" /> 앨라배마의 오랜 가문 출신의 부유한 농장주로. <break time="0.8s" /> 노예를 소유한 사람이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 열렬히 지지했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 전쟁에서 남부 쪽을. <break time="0.8s" /> 군대에 들어갈 수 없어서. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 어쩔 수 없는 이유로. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 기회를 간절히 바랐다. <break time="0.8s" /> 남부를 위해 용감한 일을 할. <break time="0.8s" /> 어느 날 저녁. <break time="0.8s" /> 파쿼와 그의 아내가. <break time="0.8s" /> 대문 근처 벤치에 앉아 있을 때. <break time="0.8s" /> 회색 군복을 입은 병사 한 명이. <break time="0.8s" /> 말을 타고 그들에게 다가왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 파쿼 부인은 기꺼이. <break time="0.8s" /> 그에게 물 한 잔을 가져다주었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그녀가 자리를 비운 사이. <break time="0.8s" /> 남편은 열심히 물었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 전선의 소식을. <break time="0.8s" /> 병사는 말했다 북군이 아울 크리크 다리에 이르렀다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그곳에서 그들은 철도를 고치고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 작은 요새를 세웠다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 붙잡힌 민간인은 누구든. <break time="0.8s" /> 철도나 다리를 망가뜨리다가. <break time="0.8s" /> 교수형에 처해질 겁니다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 덧붙였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 제가 그 명령서를 직접 봤습니다. <break time="0.8s" /> 파쿼는 웃으며 물었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 용감한 사람이 그곳에서 무엇을 할 수 있을지. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 보초를 몰래 지나갈 수 있다면. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 보초는 다리 끝에 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 병사는 대답했다 마른 유목 더미가 잔뜩. <break time="0.8s" /> 나무 교각에 기대어 있다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그것은 아주 쉽게 탈 거라고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그날 밤늦게. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 병사는 농장을 지나 되돌아갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 반대 방향으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 왜냐하면 그는 사실. <break time="0.8s" /> 변장한 북군 정찰병이었기 때문이다.

As Farquhar fell straight down. <break time="0.8s" /> Between the timbers of the bridge. <break time="0.8s" /> He lost consciousness. <break time="0.8s" /> And seemed to be already dead. <break time="0.8s" /> He was awakened. <break time="0.8s" /> By a sharp pain in his throat. <break time="0.8s" /> And then he felt. <break time="0.8s" /> As if he could not breathe at all. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly the rope broke. <break time="0.8s" /> And he fell into the stream. <break time="0.8s" /> With a loud splash. <break time="0.8s" /> The cold water closing over his head. <break time="0.8s" /> Deep under the water. <break time="0.8s" /> He fought to free his hands. <break time="0.8s" /> And at last the cord around his wrists. <break time="0.8s" /> Gave way. <break time="0.8s" /> He tore the rope from his neck. <break time="0.8s" /> And rose to the surface. <break time="0.8s" /> Where he took a deep breath. <break time="0.8s" /> Of the sweet air. <break time="0.8s" /> Never before had his senses been so sharp. <break time="0.8s" /> For he could see every leaf. <break time="0.8s" /> On the trees. <break time="0.8s" /> And even the tiny insects on them. <break time="0.8s" /> Looking back. <break time="0.8s" /> He saw the bridge, the fort, and the soldiers. <break time="0.8s" /> Who were pointing at him and shouting. <break time="0.8s" /> The captain gave orders. <break time="0.8s" /> In a calm, slow voice. <break time="0.8s" /> And the guards began to fire their rifles. <break time="0.8s" /> At the man in the water. <break time="0.8s" /> Bullets struck the water. <break time="0.8s" /> All around him. <break time="0.8s" /> So he dived as deep as he could and swam hard with the current.

파쿼가 곧장 아래로 떨어지면서. <break time="0.8s" /> 다리의 들보 사이로. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 의식을 잃었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 이미 죽은 것처럼 보였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 깨어났다. <break time="0.8s" /> 목의 날카로운 통증 때문에. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러고 나서 그는 느꼈다. <break time="0.8s" /> 마치 숨을 전혀 쉴 수 없는 것처럼. <break time="0.8s" /> 갑자기 밧줄이 끊어졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그는 개울로 떨어졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 큰 첨벙 소리와 함께. <break time="0.8s" /> 차가운 물이 그의 머리 위를 덮으며. <break time="0.8s" /> 깊은 물속에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 손을 풀려고 애썼다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 마침내 손목을 묶은 끈이. <break time="0.8s" /> 풀렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 목에서 밧줄을 잡아 뜯었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 수면으로 떠올랐다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그곳에서 그는 숨을 깊이 들이마셨다. <break time="0.8s" /> 달콤한 공기를. <break time="0.8s" /> 그의 감각이 이토록 예민했던 적은 전에 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 잎 하나하나를 볼 수 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 나무들에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그 위의 작은 벌레들까지도. <break time="0.8s" /> 뒤를 돌아보며. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 다리와 요새와 군인들을 보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 그를 가리키며 소리치고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 대위가 명령을 내렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 차분하고 느린 목소리로. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러자 보초들이 소총을 쏘기 시작했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 물속의 남자를 향해. <break time="0.8s" /> 총알들이 물을 때렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그의 주위 사방에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 그는 할 수 있는 한 깊이 잠수했다 그리고 물살을 따라 힘껏 헤엄쳤다.
